Maya (Product): Customer FinReg asked for per-tenant + per-route cost visibility and correlated traces with PII-redaction for audit teams. They want a dashboard tile and a trace sample they can download. Need to scope Q2 MVP.
Liam (Eng): Quick note: per-token lineage for every request is expensive. We can do aggregated per-route cost (buckets) + sampled traces. Sampling and redaction are the heavy lifts.
Sophia (SRE): Agree with Liam. Storage + retention policy for sampled traces is the cost driver. We should set default sampling to 1% and allow tenant override. Also need to ensure redaction runs before trace storage.
Alex (Customer Success): From FinReg: must be able to prove no PII is stored and get a CSV of sampled traces for a specific date range. They care about latency spikes when enabling tracing.
Sam (Solutions): For demos, a dashboard widget that shows "Cost by Route (7d)" + a link to "Sampled Trace Export" should be enough to prove value. Keep UI minimal: date selector, tenant selector, csv export.
Maya (Product): Proposed MVP cuts: 1) Aggregated per-route cost buckets (no token-level logs), 2) Stable-sampling traces with pre-storage redaction, 3) Console tile + CSV export of sampled traces, 4) Opt-in tenant flag. Launch criteria: instrumented for a single customer and internal load test pass. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Liam (Eng): Implementation sketch: add ingress trace hook that tags route_id and tenant_id, run deterministic sampling (seeded by tenant+day) so exports are reproducible, then feed into short-term hot storage (7 days) and cold S3 for exports. Will need a small schema change and a new microservice for redaction + export. Pseudoconfig: 
```
trace_sampling:
  mode: stable
  rate: 0.01
  redaction_patterns:
    - email
    - ssn

    - credit_card
```
Maya (Product): Good. Can we meet the redaction proof requirement? FinReg expects an audit report showing redaction rules applied.
Sophia (SRE): We'll add redaction logs (hashes only) and a verification job that samples outputs and runs redaction checks. That job can produce the audit report. Keep logs scrubbed: only store redaction events (pattern matched) as counts, not raw values.
Alex (Customer Success): I'll ask FinReg for example PII samples and their export format. Also confirm acceptable sampling rate and retention.
Sam (Solutions): For the console UI, I'll draft a mockup: minimal tile + modal with trace list + export button. No heavy filtering for MVP.
Liam (Eng): Rough effort: 3 sprints (infra + trace hook + redaction service + console stubs). If we cut to one tenant pilot and aggregated export only, we can shrink to ~2 sprints.
Maya (Product): Prioritization question: is this higher priority than the cost-allocation by model? We have limited eng bandwidth.
Sophia (SRE): From ops side, this helps with hotspot debugging too. So it's high ROI. But note quantization/kv-cache affects token attribution accuracy — call it best-effort.
Liam (Eng): Suggested MVP trade: no per-token cost attribution, only per-request aggregated token counts multiplied by config-cost-per-token to estimate cost per route. Accurate enough for audit.
Maya (Product): OK. Action items: 1) Alex to collect FinReg export sample + acceptance criteria (due EOD Friday), 2) Liam to draft design doc + infra checklist (due next Tue), 3) Sam to share UI mockup (due next Wed), 4) Sophia to propose retention + verification job (due next Wed). I'll schedule a 30m sync after docs.
Alex (Customer Success): On it. I'll ask whether they need signed attestations too.
deploy-bot: Flag created: feature/trace-sampling-redaction (private) :white_check_mark:
Maya (Product): Thanks. If design looks good, we'll slot this for Q2 beta with a single-customer pilot and objective metrics: exportable CSV sample, redaction verification report, console tile rendering <200ms. :eyes:
Liam (Eng): Noted. Will call out known risks in doc (storage costs, sampling edge cases, retained partial traces).
Sophia (SRE): Also add SLO: sampling pipeline should not add >5ms p99 to request path when off-path async processing is used.
Maya (Product): Perfect. Wrapping up — next update in design doc PR. Thanks team.
